description: This file implements utility functions and classes for managing network connections using the Happy Eyeballs algorithm, including custom HTTP/HTTPS agents, socket creation, and address lookup logic.

classes.name: HttpHappyEyeballsAgent
classes.description: Custom HTTP agent that implements connection logic with Happy Eyeballs algorithm.

classes.name: HttpsHappyEyeballsAgent
classes.description: Custom HTTPS agent that implements connection logic with Happy Eyeballs algorithm.

methods.name: createSocket
methods.description: Creates a network socket connection to the specified host and port, handling both IP and hostname resolution.

methods.name: createTLSSocket
methods.description: Creates a TLS socket connection with hostname verification.

methods.name: createConnectionAsync
methods.description: Establishes network connections asynchronously using the Happy Eyeballs algorithm, with support for both TLS and non-TLS connections.

methods.name: timingForSocket
methods.description: Returns timing information (DNS lookup and TCP connection times) for a given socket.
